reference: Case-pool entry EULER-VORTEX-ERR cites Yee, Sandham & Djomehri (2000) with a <6 % tolerance; the analytic isentropic-vortex solution itself is the standard form documented in Shu (1998) sec. 4.4.2 (domain [-5,5]^2, beta=5, u_inf=(1,1), gamma=1.4, periodic). The tolerance is taken from the case-pool entry verbatim and is NOT re-derived from the paper text (the paper is not available in-repo); the acceptance numbers below are therefore measured against the analytic solution, which is independent of which paper introduced it.

reference_model.note: both solvers close their faces periodically, so the exact solution is evaluated through the periodic map; `min_image` folds the displacement onto the nearest image only and drops the neighbouring tails, `lattice` sums them (exact up to O(tail^2)) -- see docs/CASE-DG-EULER-VORTEX-ERR-reference-floor.md
reference_model.truncated_images: min_image: next image shell at radial distance >= box - |shift| >= 5 -> envelope ratio ~6e-6 -> measured 4e-13 relative L2 in density/pressure (second order in the envelope) but 1.5e-6 in velocity (first order, displacement-weighted)

provenance.note: `recorded` = the result file carries the reference model it was measured against; `replayed` = legacy record (no model in the file) certified by a re-run of the same checkpoint against the current reference; `unverified` = legacy record with no certificate, i.e. its numbers are not shown to belong to the current reference

C1_tolerance.criterion: every family at the design checkpoint t=1: max-field relative L2 < 6% (snapshot tolerance)

C1x_crosscheck_raw.criterion: INFORMATIONAL: raw max-field relative L2 over *every* long-time checkpoint, vs 6%
C1x_crosscheck_raw.note: reported for transparency only: the first-order P0 family exceeds the snapshot tolerance during long-time transport; accumulation is what C2 measures, and C5 keeps the cross-check honest

C2_error_conservation.criterion: dg_d2_n32_cfl0.2: least-squares exponent of e ~ t^alpha over t = 1..20 satisfies alpha <= 1.0 (no super-linear accumulation)

C3_discrete_conservation.criterion: drift of mass/x-mom/y-mom/energy vs the t=0 discrete state, scaled by the transported amount max(|reference|, mass*|u_inf|) < 1e-10

C5_crosscheck_order.criterion: P0 cross-check observed order at t=1 over n=64/128/256 >= 0.8 (first order; confirms the second code path converges)

C6_ladder_completeness.criterion: every checkpoint declared in LADDER has a result record (40 declared)
C6_ladder_completeness.note: unexpected keys are listed for transparency but are not a failure: extra evidence is allowed, missing evidence is not. A missing checkpoint with a submitted job reads not_evaluated (INCOMPLETE), never passed

C7_design_space_invariance.criterion: every DG design point (mesh x CFL x degree) with >= 3 checkpoints satisfies alpha <= 1.0, and at least 2 such points exist

C8_degree_invariance.criterion: every DG degree in [1, 2, 3] with >= 3 checkpoints satisfies alpha <= 1.0, and at least 2 distinct degrees are decidable

C10_direction_invariance.criterion: every declared advection direction at dg_d2_n32_cfl0.2 (mesh x CFL x degree held fixed) satisfies alpha <= 1.0, at least 2 directions are decidable and at least one of them is rotated off the grid diagonal

C9_design_order.criterion: observed spatial order over n=[32, 64] reaches 0.8 * (p + 1) for every degree in [1, 2] at t in [1.0, 10.0]

C7x_design_space_spread.criterion: INFORMATIONAL: max-field error at t = 10 per DG design point, and the two one-at-a-time ratios

C7x_amplification_prediction.prediction: A(t=10) = e(10)/e(0) on the refined mesh (dg_d2_n64_cfl0.2) must not exceed A(t=10) on the design mesh (dg_d2_n32_cfl0.2)

C11_provenance_integrity.criterion: every record on disk matches its declared configuration (physics fields) and either records the reference model it was measured against or carries a replay certificate that reproduces its errors to 1e-09 against the aggregated model
